title: Axolotl: egg to adult
caption:
From a dot in jelly to a pink adult that never fully grows up.

A female axolotl can lay 100 to 300 eggs, attaching them to plants or rocks under water.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Ambystoma mexicanum). Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
